'''2011 Worlds Day 2 Aaron Nelson DS Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Aaron Nelson]] at [[2011 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Sheet username '''Airdog 2003'''; dest [[Aaron Nelson]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi (V) (Virtual Block 2)|Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi (V)]]
* '''Username:''' Airdog 2003
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
